condition.narrative: Should contribute directly to results for children as outlined in the UNDAF, national results and/or UNICEF Strategic Plan and within the scope defined in the CPD, CPAP, OMP or other agreed upon programme documents

title.narrative: UNICEF supported the development of a new governance framework for the Social Protection System, involving key ministries (health, education, labor), as well as civil society and international cooperation. UNICEF contributed to expanding the coverage and designing social programs based on cash transfers to poor households and children with disabilities. UNICEF helped to improve the interoperability of information systems in the nominal register of children under 6 years old in partnership with the Directorate of Targeting and Social Information of the MIDIS.
